localConstraint.cpu: Ryzen 7 class, 16GB RAM, no assumed CUDA

candidates.purpose: Benchmark and implementations for CNNSpot, FreDect, LGrad, DIRE, UnivFD, PatchCraft and related AIGC detectors.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: External links and benchmark datasets require separate rights audit.
candidates.requirements: PyTorch, torchvision, OpenCV, SciPy and model-specific dependencies
candidates.checkpoint: External Baidu/ModelScope links; size/runtime not pinned
candidates.signal: Mostly learned image-level synthetic/texture signals; candidate methods are not automatically independent.

candidates.purpose: Patch/feature based synthetic-image detection within the benchmark ecosystem.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: Benchmark-specific data and external checkpoint terms unresolved.
candidates.activity: Audited through the maintained benchmark repository.
candidates.checkpoint: Availability is not sufficient evidence of redistribution rights.
candidates.signal: Patch/semantic features may complement a spectral detector but correlation must be measured.

candidates.purpose: Self-supervised AI-generated image detection from a camera-metadata perspective using high-frequency residuals.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: Camera/EXIF training data provenance and rights must be separately verified.
candidates.requirements: Python >=3.11, PyTorch >=2.10, torchvision >=0.25; training instructions use 8 processes.
candidates.checkpoint: Backbone and binary-classifier links available but terms/size not pinned.
candidates.signal: Potentially independent learned photographic-acquisition signal; not metadata-presence proof.

candidates.purpose: All-domain image forgery detection and localization framework.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: Model zoo and benchmark data require per-model/data rights review.
candidates.requirements: Large dependency surface including IMDLBenCo, timm, transformers, flash-attn, wavelets and segmentation models.
candidates.checkpoint: Several external weight links; missing checkpoint/inference issues remain.
candidates.signal: Potential local manipulation mask and all-domain classifier; not validated on Lythaus data.

candidates.purpose: Benchmark/codebase for image manipulation detection and localization.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: CAT protocol differs from original; dataset terms and coverage require audit.
candidates.activity: v0.1.29 guidance; pushed 2026-09-04; 24 issues at audit
candidates.requirements: NumPy<2, albumentations, timm, fvcore, Grad-CAM and PyTorch ecosystem.
candidates.checkpoint: Pretrained checkpoints are linked externally; no compact CPU artifact established.
candidates.signal: Region localization/mask signal, materially different from generic VLM semantics.

candidates.purpose: Open-world diffusion-generated image spotting with MaskCLIP.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: README identifies CC BY-SA 4.0 data plus academic-use/liability language.
candidates.requirements: Minimal requirements file but substantial MAE/MaskCLIP and IMDLBenCo assets.
candidates.checkpoint: MaskCLIP weights referenced externally; size/redistribution not pinned.
candidates.signal: Open-world diffusion spotting; useful research control, not a production-ready specialist.

candidates.purpose: Disentangled artifact/semantic features for diffusion detection.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: OpenSDI conversion described as approximately 72GB download and 270GB converted data.
candidates.requirements: Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.2, CUDA 11.8, Docker, H100-class setup and large shared memory.
candidates.checkpoint: External pretrained CLIP-224 weights; no bounded Windows CPU artifact.
candidates.signal: Artifact/semantic disentanglement may be independent but remains GPU/frontier research.

candidates.datasetRestrictions: MFM/data rights and benchmark splits require audit.
candidates.requirements: PyTorch, CLIP git dependency, timm, apex and older pinned NumPy stack.
candidates.checkpoint: README checkpoint link reported missing in issue #17.
candidates.signal: Spectral/real-distribution signal could complement semantic patch detectors, but may correlate with current EF4.

candidates.purpose: DINOv3 Fisher-guided token selection for cross-generator detection.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: Training/validation/test benchmark terms must be audited per dataset.
candidates.requirements: PyTorch, torchvision, timm, transformers and CUDA-capable GPU recommended.
candidates.checkpoint: DINOv3 backbone plus external training/validation data; size not pinned.
candidates.signal: Token/semantic feature detector with claimed cross-generator generalization; independence from CLIP-like signals unverified.

candidates.purpose: Unified AI-image detection and artifact correction.
candidates.datasetRestrictions: Training/evaluation data provenance not established for commercial use.
candidates.requirements: Torch 2.5.1, transformers, bitsandbytes/triton variants and video/decord dependencies.
candidates.checkpoint: Issues mention unreleased weights/datasets and resource cost.
candidates.signal: Potential future unified artifact evidence; current reproducibility gate fails.

candidates.purpose: Generator-aware prototypes for generalizable synthetic-image detection.
candidates.requirements: PyTorch, timm, transformers, PEFT and Hugging Face dependencies; README uses CUDA.
candidates.checkpoint: Hugging Face checkpoint referenced; inference/cache issues remain.
candidates.signal: Generator-aware prototype signal; likely semantically correlated with other image-level detectors.
